question.prompt: Point \(P\) lies on the bisector of \(\angle AOB\). Its distance to \(OA\) is \(3\). What is its distance to \(OB\)?

solutions.explanation: A point on an angle bisector is equidistant from the two sides of the angle, so the distance from \(P\) to \(OB\) is also \(3\).
solutions.title: Apply the angle-bisector property
